## Summary

Describe the failure mode or use case and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `gofmt` reports no changes
- [ ] Public behavior and documentation are synchronized

## Compatibility and safety

Note any API, concurrency, timer, context, HTTP replay, or idempotency impact.
